Jan_Sahayak.problem: Many people miss government welfare schemes they qualify for because eligibility rules are hard to find and hard to read. It asks a short set of questions and lists the schemes the user is eligible for.
Jan_Sahayak.contribution: Designed and built the eligibility logic and most of the backend. Rules are deterministic and explainable, so every result shows why a scheme does or doesn't apply.

trustlens-ai.title: TrustLens AI
trustlens-ai.problem: Scams such as lookalike domains, fake refund requests and deceptive pages are hard for ordinary users to spot. It flags them and explains the risk in plain language.
trustlens-ai.contribution: Designed and built the whole system alone, from the detection rules and browser extension to the desktop client. Built as a hackathon prototype.

Base_Converter.contribution: My first project after learning C, written to apply what I had learned. It taught me manual memory handling and positional number systems.

MedPulse.title: MedPulse
MedPulse.description: Price comparison for Indian prescription medicines and diagnostic lab tests.
MedPulse.problem: Medicine and lab-test prices vary widely across pharmacies and labs, and patients rarely see the cheaper options.
MedPulse.contribution: Designed the application logic and built the backend (team project).
